dtr_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: GPIO pin to use as the DTR (Data Terminal Ready) modem control output. The state of this pin may be controlled by the API client at runtime.

*See also: [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID to use for code generation.

*See also: [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy#configuration-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: A human-readable name for this serial port, used to identify it to API clients.

*See also: [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy#configuration-variables)*

TTL.docs: Standard TTL logic-level UART (3.3V or 5V). Typically used for direct connections to most microcontrollers.

RS232.docs: RS-232 standard serial port (typically ±12V levels via an appropriate line-driver IC). Typically used for PC-style serial connections, often with a DB9-type connector.

RS485.docs: RS-485 differential serial bus. Typically used for industrial/multi-drop serial networks.

rts_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: GPIO pin to use as the RTS (Request to Send) modem control output. The state of this pin may be controlled by the API client at runtime.

*See also: [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [UART](https://esphome.io/components/uart/) component this proxy is attached to.

*See also: [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy#configuration-variables)*
